svg.text: assemble · sign · append · THEN answer — the order is the product, not an implementation detail
800 ms self-budget, under the 1000 ms floor the caller can configure
late is not slow: it is a transport failure, and enough of them stop enforcement for everyone
if the log cannot take it
both signed, so a report is
the code, the token, the fix
and the leaf that proves it
Returning first and logging after would produce a verdict that was acted on and never recorded.
a gap in an append-only log is indistinguishable from a deletion
